## [0.5.0] - 2026-11-09 (beta)

### Added
- **Resource packs can restyle JustQuests** (requested on GitHub, #21). On every version with the
  quest book (1.20.1 to 26.3), a pack in `assets/justquests/` can change:
  - the quest book (`textures/gui/quest_book/book.png`), its quest rows, group headers, the line
    between rows and the progress bar, which can also be a picture per step (`state_1.png` to
    `state_100.png`);
  - every button and its states (`buttons/`), the small symbols (`icons/glyphs/`), an icon for any
    category (`icons/categories/<id>.png`) and a picture for any quest (`icons/quests/<namespace>/<path>.png`);
  - the tracker, with a picture that stretches like a frame and an optional progress bar per goal;
  - places, colours, text shadows and the background behind the book, in one `settings.json` per
    folder;
  - the font of the book, the tracker and the popups (`font/book.json`);
  - a sound for every moment: `justquests:quest.complete`, `quest.accept`, `quest.abandon`,
    `quest.unlock`, `reward.claim`, `goal.progress`, `goal.complete`, `book.open`, `book.close`,
    `book.page`, `book.click` and `popup.show`. The ones without a sound so far are empty, so a pack
    can add one.
  Pictures may be HD (a whole multiple of their size) and animated with a `.png.mcmeta`. Packs with
  the old picture names (`window.png`, `button_claim_normal.png` …) keep working.
- **Popups** for a completed quest ("Quest completed!", or how to claim the reward) and for a newly
  unlocked quest. Players can turn them off with a new box on the quest book's overview page.
- An **example resource pack** in `docs/example-resourcepack` that uses every feature.

### Changed
- Clicks in the quest book now play the normal button click (`justquests:book.click`).
- Players with JustQuests hear the completion sound as `justquests:quest.complete`. By default it is
  the same challenge sound as before; players without the mod still hear the vanilla sound.

## [0.4.6] - 2026-11-01

### Added
- **Ready for addons:** other mods can add objective types with `QuestObjective.register`. The first
  one is the **JustQuests Create Addon**, with goals that count what Create's machines really make,
  such as "Press Iron Sheet". It is a separate download, so JustQuests itself stays small and still
  doesn't need Create. (Requested on GitHub, #15.)

### Changed
- A client without an addon the server has no longer sees an empty quest book: only the quests that
  use the addon's objectives stay off it.

mods.name: JustQuests Create Addon
mods.description: Quest objectives for Create's machines in JustQuests: press, mix, crush, assemble and more.

releases.notes:
First version of the **JustQuests Create Addon**, for NeoForge 1.21.1.

**Needs:** [JustQuests](https://github.com/ErikEdits/JustQuests/releases/tag/v0.4.6) 0.4.6 or newer and [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) 6.0.10, on the client and the server.

### Added
- **Quest objectives for Create's machines.** Each counts what one kind of machine really makes: `press_item`, `compact_item`, `mix_item`, `mill_item`, `crush_item`, `saw_item`, `deploy_item`, `fill_item`, `mechanical_craft_item`, `wash_item`, `smoke_item`, `blast_item`, `haunt_item` and `assemble_item`, all under `justquests_create:`. (Requested in #15.)
- The quest book shows them in words, such as "0/16 Press Iron Sheet", with the item as the icon. English, German, Spanish, French and Japanese.
- **Who gets the progress:** the player who placed the machine, wherever they are on the server. A machine without a known owner (placed before the addon, built by a schematic) counts for the nearest player within 32 blocks. An owner who is offline gets nothing.

An [example datapack](https://github.com/ErikEdits/JustQuests/tree/main/addons/create/example-datapack) has one quest for every objective.

## [0.4.5] - 2026-10-31

### Added
- **`have_item`:** a new objective that counts what the player has in the inventory, wherever it came
  from - a machine of another mod (Create, Mekanism and so on), a chest or a trade. The most the
  player has held at once counts, and the progress does not go back. Mod and plugin. (Requested on
  GitHub, #15.)
- **`label` on objectives:** any objective can bring its own goal text, as a string or a per-language
  map, for example "Press Iron Sheets". The quest book, the tracker and the chat show it instead of
  the generated goal line. Mod and plugin. (Requested on GitHub, #15.)

### Fixed
- Abandoning a quest showed its id in the chat ("Abandoned quest: justquests:mining/iron") instead of
  its title. (Reported on GitHub, #14.)

## [0.4.4] - 2026-10-29

### Added
- **Alternative objectives: `group`.** Objectives with the same `"group"` are alternatives, and one
  of them is enough: "craft a Standard Backpack **or** find any backpack". Objectives without a
  group are all still needed, so both can be mixed in one quest. The quest book, the tracker,
  `/quest list` and `/quest progress` show "- or -" between them. Mod and plugin. (Requested on
  GitHub, #10.)
- **Unlocked quests start by themselves.** When a finished quest unlocks others, they are accepted
  at once, with a line in the chat. Players who would rather choose turn it off with
  `/quest autoaccept off` or the box on the quest book's start page; they get the new quest in the
  chat with an Accept button instead. Server owners set the default with `autoAccept`. Team quests
  only get the button. Mod and plugin. (Requested on GitHub, #12.)
- **Accept all:** `/quest accept all` and an "Accept all" button on the quest book's start page
  take every quest that is available (not team quests and generated quests). Mod and plugin. (#12)
- **Fold groups in the quest book:** a click on a category's (or status group's) header folds it,
  so the next category is right there; an arrow shows which groups are folded, and the book
  remembers them. A search still finds quests in folded groups. (Requested on GitHub, #11.)
- A second click on the selected quest goes back to the book's start page.

### Changed
- The scroll bar of a long quest page is easier to see: a dark track with a light thumb that
  shows where the page is. A click on the track jumps there. (Requested on GitHub, #6.)

### Fixed
- `gain_advancement` goals showed the advancement's id ("Earn advancement mypack:story/let_me_go")
  instead of its title. They show the title now ("Earn advancement Please Let me go!"), also on
  servers, and the id made readable for an advancement without a title. Mod and plugin. (Reported
  on GitHub, #13.)
- The example datapack (`docs/example-datapack`) was shown as incompatible on Minecraft 26.x: its
  `pack.mcmeta` now names the newer `min_format`/`max_format` fields as well. It has a new
  example, `ex_group`.

## [0.4.3] - 2026-10-28

### Fixed
- Quest book on Minecraft 1.21.6 and newer (Fabric 1.21.6 - 26.3, NeoForge 1.21.6 - 26.2): the
  game crashed as soon as the book opened ("Can only blur once per frame") while the menu
  background blur was on, which is the default. Since 1.21.6 Minecraft draws the blurred
  background itself, and the book drew it a second time. Setting "Menu Background Blur" to 0 was
  the workaround. (Reported on Discord.)
- Quest book on the same versions: the window, buttons and rows were drawn as black boxes
  reaching to the top-left corner of the screen instead of the book's textures.
- Quest book on Minecraft 26.3 (Fabric): clicks did nothing. 26.3 reads the mouse through SDL,
  where the left button is 1 instead of 0.

## [0.4.2] - 2026-10-25

### Added
- **Soft requirements: `requires_min`.** Next to `requires`, a quest can say how many of those
  quests must be done first: `"requires": [16 quests], "requires_min": 12` unlocks as soon as any
  12 of them are done. The quest book shows "Needs 12 of 16 quests (5 done)". (Requested on GitHub.)
- **`reset_on_death`:** a quest with `"reset_on_death": true` loses its progress when the player
  dies (a team quest: when any member dies). The quest book and `/quest list` say so, and the
  player gets a message when it happens. (Requested on GitHub.)
- **Every kind once: `"distinct": true`** on an objective counts each kind of item, block or mob
  only once - `consume_item` with `"item": "#c:foods"`, `"count": 10` and `"distinct": true`
  needs 10 different foods. The goal reads "(all different)". (Requested on GitHub.)

### Changed
- A quest without rewards is simply done when it is finished: no Claim button and no "Rewards
  received" for nothing to claim. Mod and plugin.
- The examples in a new `custom-quests.json` are only an explanation now: their keys start with
  `_`, so they no longer show up as quests. Copy one and remove the `_` to use it. Files that
  already exist stay as they are. (Reported on GitHub.)

### Fixed
- Fabric: `collect_item` didn't count items picked up from the ground when the whole stack went
  into the inventory (only a part taken by a nearly full inventory counted). NeoForge, Forge and
  the plugin were not affected.
- The `loot_table` reward gave nothing on every version (the loot was rolled without the player,
  which the game refuses; the server log showed "Loot-table reward failed"). Mod only; the plugin
  was not affected.
- `gain_advancement` counts an advancement the player already had before taking the quest. Before,
  such a quest could never be finished. Mod and plugin.
- Quest book: quests added to or changed in `custom-quests.json` while the world runs show up in
  the book at once (the file reloaded by itself, but the book only got the new list after a
  rejoin or `/quest reload`).
- Quest book: a quest page with a long description or many objectives scrolls with the mouse
  wheel instead of cutting the rest off. (Reported on GitHub.)
- Quest book: long objective names (advancements, tags) wrap onto the next line instead of being
  cut off with "...". Reward lines and choice options wrap too. (Reported on GitHub.)
- A quest without rewards no longer shows an empty "Rewards" heading in the quest book or an empty
  "Reward:" line in `/quest list`. (Reported on GitHub.)

releases.notes:
## [0.4.1] - 2026-10-23

### Added
- **Settings for every world: `config/justquests.json`.** Any key of a world's `settings.json`
  set there applies to every world of the game or server and wins over the world's own file, so a
  modpack can ship, for example, `"generatedQuests": false`. Commands can't change a key set there
  and say so. The file is created with an explanation on first start. (Requested on GitHub.)
- **Folders are categories:** a quest in a sub-folder of a datapack's `justquests/quests/` (also
  the plugin's `quests/` folder, or a key like `"mining/iron"` in `custom-quests.json`) that names
  no `category` gets the folder as its category - `quests/mining/iron.json` is in "mining". Deeper
  folders only sort the files. (Requested on GitHub.)

### Changed
- `mainQuests: false` (and `/quest mainquests off`) now hides only the 25 built-in quests; quests
  from your own datapacks stay. Before, it hid every datapack quest. Mod and plugin.
- A category without a translation reads in chat as it does in the quest book: "mob_drops" shows as
  "Mob drops".
